title: Context budget step 2: global window 500k once the 200-300k band proves its quality
body:
Source: t-v9zxepq decision 2026-11-16. Operator orders (verbatim): "podnieś caps kontekstu, chcę wykorzystać 1M - ale zrób to stabilnie, serio, chcemy wszystko nadal mieć w chuj jakościowe."; "niekoniecznie musisz dawać pełny 1m ale te 400k byłoby ok"; "w sensie kurwa 400k to mój guess zrób rsearch i sam ustal jak to zrobic zajebiscie".
Current (t-v9zxepq): global window 400k in ~/.claude/settings.json, thresholds at 1/2, 5/8, 3/4 of it: advisories 200k/250k, ceiling 300k.
Outcome: the global window reads 500000 only after analyze_peak.py prints verdict pass for the 200-300k band (at least 30 lead-shipped merges); otherwise the window stays 400000.
Change: global autoCompactWindow 500000 -> advisories 250k/312k, ceiling 375k (the operator's ~400k working context).
Gate (all must hold before step 2):
1. >= 30 merged PRs authored by lead sessions whose peak gauge context was 200-300k (step-1 band), mapped PR->session.
2. first-push-green in that band within 10 percentage points of the <150k band, and rework (fix( PR <= 48 h on the same task or files) not more than 10 points above it.
3. t-ahsmyfp (global usage cut) shipped, because a 500k window raises cache-read cost per turn to ~135% of 150k host-wide.
Measure: .krn/runs/lead/context-budget/analyze_peak.py (prints a final verdict: line); baseline 2026-11-16: <150k 85% FPG n=20, 150-200k 71% n=17, 200k+ n=3. Its PR->session mapping covers only 41 of 654 PRs (matches PR URLs in transcripts); improve the mapping (ledger lead attribution) first, or the gate never fills.
Proof: analyze_peak.py prints verdict pass for the 200-300k band and ~/.claude/settings.json autoCompactWindow reads 500000
Files: ~/.claude/settings.json, src/context/gauge.ts, .krn/runs/lead/context-budget/analyze_peak.py
